limitations: Counterevidence: If the currents were explicitly the canonical unit currents, this example would be excluded; that condition is not a consequence of a manifold support and is not in Assumption1.3. The limiting projection here is an isometry, so the example does not disprove Proposition1.4's conclusion. It demonstrates precisely the auxiliary equation and mass identification claimed in the report.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
